# Bonett & Wright (2000): se = sqrt((1+rho^2/2)/(n-3))

def spearman_ci_bw(rho, n, z_val=1.96):
    se = math.sqrt((1 + rho**2/2) / (n - 3))
    z = math.atanh(rho)
    ci_lower = math.tanh(z - z_val * se)
    ci_upper = math.tanh(z + z_val * se)
    return ci_lower, ci_upper
